newsitem.title: HONG KONG: FPB Bank to raise HK$700 mln, issues shrs.
newsitem.headline: FPB Bank to raise HK$700 mln, issues shrs.

text.p: FPB Bank Holdings Co Ltd said on Friday it would raise HK$700 million in new capital and was issuing 175 million new shares to its two major shareholders.

In a statement, the company said FPMF Ltd and MIMET FOTIC Investment Ltd are placing an aggregate of 43.75 million shares to independent investors at HK$4.00 per share and subscribing for 175 million new shares.
It did not mention the subscription price.
Following completion of the deal, the two major shareholders would continue to hold 75 percent of the company, it said.
The new shares represent 14.02 percent of its enlarged share capital, the company said.
It did not say what the proceeds would be used for.
Trading in FPB Bank shares was suspended at the company's request on Friday morning. After resuming trade, the shares closed HK$0.375 higher at HK$4.525.

FPMF Ltd is a subsidiary of First Pacific Co Ltd, while MIMET FOTIC is a joint venture of Chinese state firms China National Metals and Minerals Import and Export Corp and China Trust and Investment Corp for Foreign Economic Relations and Trade.
